items.title: India Achieves Guinness World Record for Planting 3.61 Lakh Trees in One Hour
items.whyInNews: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah congratulated the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, volunteers, and residents for achieving the Guinness World Record for planting 3.61 lakh trees in one hour using the Miyawaki method in the Gandhinagar Lok Sabha constituency on July 13, 2026.
items.summary: The event was held in the Gandhinagar Lok Sabha constituency, where 3.61 lakh trees were planted in just one hour. Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah congratulated the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, volunteers, and residents for this achievement. The Miyawaki method of afforestation involves planting multiple trees in a small area, which helps in rapid growth and higher density of the forest.

items.title: BRICS Transport Ministers Adopt Ministerial Declaration in Nagpur
items.whyInNews: The third meeting of the BRICS Transport Ministers was held in Nagpur, Maharashtra, where the ministers adopted a ministerial declaration under India's BRICS presidency.
items.summary: The meeting was attended by transport ministers from Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa. The ministers discussed various issues related to transportation, including road safety, sustainable transportation, and regional connectivity. The adopted ministerial declaration outlines the commitment of the BRICS nations to cooperate in the transport sector.

items.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has successfully carried out tests of the Gaganyaan crew module systems.
